facts.text: Potravu hledá tak, že zobák zasouvá do bahna.
facts.quote: Using the long bill, an individual probes the mud or other substrate for suitable food.

facts.text: Živí se krabi a dalšími drobnými bezobratlými.
facts.quote: The usual food consists of crabs and various other small invertebrates.

facts.text: Žere také kobylky, brouky a další hmyz.
facts.quote: The species also feeds on grasshoppers, beetles, and other insects.

facts.text: Hnízdo je malá prohlubeň vystlaná plevelem a trávou.
facts.quote: A small hollow is lined with various weeds and grasses to serve as the nest.

facts.text: Mláďata opouštějí hnízdo brzy po vylíhnutí.
facts.quote: the chicks leaving the nest soon after hatching

facts.text: Samice má mnohem delší zobák než samec.
facts.quote: the female being larger and having a much longer bill than the male's
